scripts.build: pnpm run clean && pnpm run build:host && pnpm run build:client
scripts.test: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:run
scripts.check: pnpm run dynamic:check && pnpm run test && pnpm run pack:check
scripts.pack:check: pnpm --filter @flowboard/contracts pack --pack-destination ../../artifacts --dry-run && pnpm --filter @flowboard/server pack --pack-destination ../../artifacts --dry-run && pnpm --filter @flowboard/dsh-service pack --pack-destination ../../artifacts --dry-run && pnpm --filter @flowboard/dsh-client pack --pack-destination ../../artifacts --dry-run && pnpm --filter @flowboard/dsh pack --pack-destination ../../artifacts --dry-run
